name: PartnerDealRegistration
tagline: Partner Deal Registration is the "Register a deal" field for your partner portal.
description: Partner Deal Registration is the "Register a deal" field for your partner portal. A reseller or system integrator enters the end customer, the customer's website or email domain, the estimated deal value, when the deal should close, the products and the sales stage. While they type, the control checks your channel programme's rules and tells them straight away whether the deal is Eligible, Needs review or Not eligible - and the date the deal will be protected until.
features: The partner enters the end customer
Website or email domain, estimated value
The control checks the channel programme's rules live - minimum deal size, close-date horizon
Conflicts with named direct accounts and minimum stage - into Eligible / Needs review / Not eligible with the deal-protection end date
Stores the registration as readable text in one column (optionally the value in a second decimal column)
